comparison: Same instrument and common cap, high A minus high B. Also report both low and no additional support. Years 2-8 are all none.
gate: Compare first-year and eight-year total grain. Start stage 2 only if at least one same-instrument contrast has opposite signs and both Bonferroni intervals exclude zero, across two instruments and two windows. Stage 1 is an allocation and dynamic persistence experiment, not an equal realized cost comparison.
next_stage_if_pass: Use disjoint development and evaluation seed ranges. Fitted tabular Q and myopic use the same opening public grain bins, remaining horizon and common action samples; strong regional fixed chosen only in development. Common annual spending cap masks infeasible joint moves. Report grains, paid budget, downstream grain and the two-objective frontier separately.
